test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: MEOP is related to KCMN in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, LTDG is related to JRBE. To which of the following is UNTF related to, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (2) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• MEOP is written as KCMN

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98dbd9c03581a4ed4dbaaeb1e959344e72cb1c33f29f0a622cb5a2b4564a7df3.png] 

And,

 
• LTDG is written as JRBE

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b636502c8d57bf407bc86ed1a323464409e58b462daeb7398cc919f0a10b2d6.png] 

Similarly,

 
• UNTF is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d1b00f091579a04c5485be76c6eb6e20146da1e0eb17b77499ad480c7538754.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**SLRD**".

c1:T
